name: latex2word
description: Claude Code plugin that converts LaTeX manuscripts to submission-ready Word files

plugins.name: latex-to-word
plugins.description: Convert a LaTeX manuscript or Supporting Information into a submission-ready Word .docx: numbered equations, SVG figures (multi-panel figures as typeset), tables, live EndNote citations from a per-paper library (or static citations), DOI checks, journal-ready figure PDFs, a marked copy against an earlier version, and sentence-level verification against the compiled PDF. Ready-made pipelines for elsarticle and achemso; other classes are adapted.
